status: Partial human reconstruction of RH and unrestricted Dirichlet GRH, accepting the pinned Alpoge-Claude formal proof as correct. Version 0.52 adds 87 independently reviewed numbered claims, bringing the cumulative inventory to 3279. It completes both full Bessel quotient theorems and BesselNVGap, the full Dat/Host arithmetic entries and finite-end transport, the original Selmer-signature comparison, and the universal algebra and full conditional global section laws. No additional whole selected obligation is closed: 24 remain, comprising 17 class C and 7 class B, with 17 shared RH/GRH and 7 additional Dirichlet-GRH obligations. Actual geometric section-law suppliers and Moduli, P/FinPt and automorphic producers, coherent Wach comparison and the actual ConclF family, and global spectral/row compatibility remain explicit. The complete GLOBAL_LOCAL_GAIN closure from v0.49 is preserved. Counts are inventories, not completion percentages. No Lean build or kernel replay is claimed.
local_conclusions: GSL1-GSL26 give a direct universal-basis proof of the original conditional global section laws. A finite matrix certificate D0*B=0, C*B=rI and B*C+H*D0=rI makes the columns of B a basis of the actual kernel after every ring map inverting r. A bounded flat complex descended from the supplied Noetherian section cube has a finite-projective model valid after every tensor product. Its fixed chart coordinates give every Perf field. The geometric vanishing, rank and translated-power reductions retain their exact named inputs. One neighborhood and one basis work before all affine tests; over a local ring the residue-field nonzero denominator is already a unit, so every residue section lifts on the literal twist bundle. No reducedness, Noetherian or flatness restriction is added to the target algebra. Actual global geometric suppliers and Moduli remain explicit.

AFE1-AFE21 complete the full original Dat and Host arithmetic entries and their return to the same marked frame. CRT and image-primary character decompositions, quadratic Gauss sums and the actual dyadic conductor supply all nineteen Gen fields. The Host construction includes ell=3 and produces the specified local witness at every allowed place. The CAF modulus is chosen before L and w, and the LFC frame, C0 and g1 are unchanged in both full P-to-frame implications. The actual auxiliary Host frame and all Marks fields are constructed. Ordinary triangular characters descend through the original Galois quotient over every allowed local Noetherian domain; no completeness or flatness hypothesis is added. Full FinPt-to-FinEnd then uses one fixed subgroup G_L before all coefficient algebras and points. P, the FinPt producer and the automorphic seeds/endpoints remain explicit.

BQS1-BQS23 complete both original Bessel quotient statements and the nonvanishing return. Euler polynomial identities provide the exact spectral projections. The K2 argument transfers the scalar model through a compactly averaged trace-kernel identity and controls every highest vector in the full integral root cone. K3 extracts the shifted lowest type in every nonzero unitary image, including incomplete targets, with the original h-2 margin. The generic quotient is then applied to the actual tensor map and the simultaneous kernel of all prescribed Bessel periods. This supplies the literal function space, both directions of the smooth L2 image relation, compact-group stability, shifted type/Casimir and period injectivity. Together with the inherited evaluations it proves full StepStatement and BesselNVGap. The setting return still retains Forms0; GLOBAL_SPECTRAL remains a separate producer.

SSC1-SSC17 prove the full Selmer-signature comparison on the actual complementary representation family. Trace equality gives conjugacy over the original local coefficient ring. The local bridges transport crystalline cocycles, and compatible bases of all torsion quotients handle arbitrary injective local DVR maps, even with infinite residue extensions. Compactness gives finite support for each continuous cocycle. The proof compares the actual local conditions, constructs a common DVR from SameChar, embeds the original Selmer module into the signature condition, and preserves finite and infinite normalized lengths. A common-place valuation argument and tame inertia yield the exact conductor-root bound. One attached signature has every original SelCore field and the correct twist orientation, giving the 1/ell^2 KillAt budget. DFD15 now retains only the coherent Wach HW/Fon/Cmp supplier before the original local ConclF bounds.

GSL proves the full conditional SecBaseChangeAny/St and SecTwistSt at their original scopes, with one actual basis before every affine test and every residue section. Its unconditional algebra gives the universal kernel certificate, arbitrary tensor transfer, finite-projective models from the supplied Noetherian section cube, and all Perf coordinates. The remaining geometric suppliers are the actual Noetherian section-cube model and finite cohomology/smooth descent, PolBaseChangeSt, Serre and multiplication/invariant descent, geometric integrality, principal rank one and section decomposition/growth, and the theorem-of-square generators. These must hold on the same polarized abelian scheme before applying GSL26 to the completed TDR/NFR/NFL uniformization. The supplied Moduli and inherited HUF/PUN foundations remain explicit. Then construct the finite level system, Gaussian/reproduction, short-rule and simultaneous dictionaries, ramified jets, higher CoversAt, all-tuple class sums and uniqueness with phases, one PointIdentCore with common lambda and z, and base ClassSumsSpan. Preserve both levels, the entire coefficient field, Fits and eta agreements, and the common-family quantifier order.
